PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS"
NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION_ID="22.04"
---
name: umwelt_navi_app
description: The app shows all the information about user's surrounding areas, environmental conditions, natural habitants, interesting locations and more.
publish_to: "none"

# app version / build number
version: 2.8.0+1

environment:
  sdk: ">=3.3.0 <4.0.0"

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_localizations:
    sdk: flutter

  intl: ^0.20.2
  async: ^2.9.0

  # storage
  path: ^1.8.3
  path_provider: ^2.1.1
  objectbox: ^4.0.1
  objectbox_flutter_libs: any

  # http
  http: ^1.5.0
  http_parser: ^4.1.2
  retry: ^3.1.2
  cupertino_http: ^2.4.0
  cronet_http: ^1.7.0
  xml: ^6.5.0

  # system
  vibration: ^3.1.3
  device_info_plus: ^11.1.0
  package_info_plus: ^8.1.0
  flutter_fgbg: ^0.7.1
  connectivity_plus: ^6.0.3
  app_settings: ^5.1.1
  permission_handler: ^11.3.1
  timezone: ^0.10.1

  # local notifications
  flutter_app_badger: ^1.5.0
  flutter_local_notifications: ^19.0.0

  # localization
  easy_localization: ^3.0.8

  # services
  get_it: ^7.7.0

  # states management
  rxdart: ^0.28.0
  equatable: ^2.0.5
  provider: ^6.1.2
  flutter_bloc: ^8.1.6

  # navigation
  auto_route: ^9.3.0+1
  fluttertoast: ^9.0.0
  page_transition: ^2.1.0
  url_launcher: ^6.3.1
  share_plus: ^12.0.2
  app_links: ^6.4.1

  # html
  html: ^0.15.4
  flutter_widget_from_html_core: ^0.15.1
  webview_flutter: ^4.8.0

  # list enhancement
  collection: ^1.18.0
  extended_sliver: ^2.1.3
  sliver_tools: ^0.2.12
  scroll_to_index: ^3.0.1
  scrollable_positioned_list: ^0.3.8
  flutter_slidable: ^3.1.1
  expandable_page_view: ^1.0.17

  # forms
  flutter_form_builder: ^10.1.0
  form_builder_validators: ^11.1.0

  # icons
  cupertino_icons: ^1.0.8

  # images
  mime: ^2.0.0
  native_exif: ^0.6.0
  gal: ^2.3.0
  image_picker: ^1.2.1
  flutter_svg: ^2.1.0

  # map
  flutter_map: ^7.0.2
  flutter_map_animations: ^0.7.1
  flutter_map_tile_caching: ^9.1.3
  latlong2: ^0.9.1
  maps_toolkit: ^3.0.0
  turf: ^0.0.10

  # location
  geolocator: ^12.0.0
  flutter_compass: ^0.8.0

  # animations
  animate_do: ^4.2.0
  simple_animations: ^5.0.2
  matrix4_transform: ^4.0.1

  # charts
  fl_chart: ^0.64.0

  # views
  widget_size: ^1.0.0
  hexcolor: ^3.0.1
  flutter_switch: ^0.3.2
  buttons_tabbar: ^1.3.8
  percent_indicator: ^4.2.3
  smooth_page_indicator: ^1.2.0+3
  flutter_layout_grid: ^2.0.7
  animated_shimmer: ^1.0.0
  shimmer: ^3.0.0

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_lints: ^4.0.0

  # test dependencies
  test: ^1.24.1
  patrol: 4.1.0
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  integration_test:
    sdk: flutter

  # navigation
  auto_route_generator: ^9.3.1

  # storage
  build_runner: ^2.4.9
  objectbox_generator: any

  # flavor
  flutter_flavorizr: ^2.2.3

  # app icon
  flutter_launcher_icons: ^0.14.1

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

  assets:
    - assets/icons/
    - assets/images/
    - assets/locale/
    - assets/keys/
    - path: assets/flavors/ni/
      flavors:
        - ni
    - path: assets/flavors/sh/
      flavors:
        - sh
    - path: assets/flavors/rp/
      flavors:
        - rp

  fonts:
    - family: Roboto
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf
          weight: 400
        - asset: assets/fonts/Roboto-Medium.ttf
          weight: 500
        - asset: assets/fonts/Roboto-Bold.ttf
          weight: 700
    - family: NotoSans
      fonts:
        - asset: assets/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf
          weight: 400
        - asset: assets/fonts/NotoSans-Italic.ttf
          weight: 400
          style: italic
        - asset: assets/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf
          weight: 700
        - asset: assets/fonts/NotoSans-BoldItalic.ttf
          weight: 700
          style: italic

# Test settings.
patrol:
  app_name: UmweltNAVI
  flavor: ni
  android:
    package_name: dev.wemove.bipu
  ios:
    bundle_id: dev.wemove.bipu

# Splash screen settings.
flutter_native_splash:
  color: "#000000"
  image: "assets/store_listing/splash.png"

observation.command: which flutter dart fvm java; echo "---"; flutter --version 2>&1 | head; echo "---"; dart --version 2>&1; echo "---"; java -version 2>&1; echo "---"; cat /etc/os-release | head -3; echo "---"; cat pubspec.yaml
